issues.correction: Model answer should state: '25 December − 28 days = 28 November.' Explanation should also state 28 November, not 29.

issues.label: 10b
issues.detail: Model answer states November (correct month) but references 27 November from part (a). Should reference corrected date of 28 November.
issues.correction: Model answer: 'The date calculated in part (a) is 28th of November, so the month is November.'

review.summary: Assessment contains 28 questions across 10 scenarios on months and date calculations. Four substantive errors identified: inconsistent date calculations in questions 7a–7b (26 vs 27 October) and 10a–10b (27 vs 28 November). Model answers conflict with explanations. Remaining questions are mathematically sound and age-appropriate for Grade 2.
